vetSays.line: A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
🍲 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

🌿 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hauls back 5 wood. The pile grows. (15 logs now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s, with a shaved head telling A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about Caleb. The retelling is already better than the event.
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Jae — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Jae chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🛡️ Caleb, Jae, Kha, Wanjiru and Jorge met them at the door — 5 put down. Caleb, Jae, Kha, Wanjiru are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caleb just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jae just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Caleb, Jae, Everett, Kiara and Kha met them at the door — 5 put down. Caleb, Jae, Everett, Kiara, Kha are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caleb just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Jae Xu, 42 — a plumber. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Echo Location, Cold-Blooded, Berserker Rage, Green Thumb, Literally.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
